result:
Step 3 has two parts: tick the plan 15 item, then file what the closure note names. The note says SMS batching is still to do and that the batch size stays at 50 until the mail host rejects a batch, so both need an item and an `→ item:` marker. Only your word could justify `→ dropped:`, and you ruled neither of them out.

Filing these also means the plan is no longer "nothing deferred", so the status header written in step 2 changes.

I'd make these changes in order, with no command to run in this step.

<edit path="specs/deferred_items.md">
Replace the first entry of `## 11-overdue-notices — 2026-10-02` with:

- [x] Reminder e-mails open one SMTP connection per message, so the nightly
      run takes about 40 minutes for 9,000 loans. See
      specs/plans/completed/11-overdue-notices.md; touches notices/mailer.py.
      → done 2026-10-30 (plan 15): e-mail only; SMS batching and the e-mail batch size of 50 are filed as items → item: 15-reminder-batching — 2026-10-30
</edit>

<edit path="specs/deferred_items.md">
Append at the end of the file:

## 15-reminder-batching — 2026-10-30
- [ ] SMS reminders still make one gateway call per message; batch them the
      way plan 15 batched e-mail (final review, owner: the next thing we want
      done, kept out of plan 15). See
      specs/plans/completed/15-reminder-batching.md. Size: plan. Done when:
      SMS reminders go out in batches, and a test shows N messages make fewer
      than N gateway calls.
- [ ] E-mail batch size is fixed at 50 (final review, owner ruled it stays
      as is). See specs/plans/completed/15-reminder-batching.md. Size:
      quick-fix. Revisit if: the mail host rejects a batch with
      `421 Too many messages`.
</edit>

<edit path="specs/plans/15-reminder-batching.md">
Replace the status header line with:

**Status: COMPLETE (2026-10-30)** — executed via subagent-driven-development; deferred items in specs/deferred_items.md
</edit>

I drafted the closure note as `→ done in plan 15`, the older undated form. I changed it to the dated `→ done 2026-10-30 (plan 15)` so the archive can count its 45 days from the tick. I also cut the note to one line, since notes are one line each.

I'd file the batch-size item as a watch item (`Revisit if:`). Your word was that it can sit until the host rejects a batch, which is a single signal that can be checked yes or no, so it won't age or hold up a merge.

**Message to my partner**

Step 3 of the completion protocol is done, apart from one correction to the status header:

- **Ticked:** the SMTP-connection-per-message item from `11-overdue-notices`, which plan 15 implemented. I used the dated note `→ done 2026-10-30 (plan 15)`.
- **Filed, new section `15-reminder-batching — 2026-10-30`:**
  1. SMS batching, `Size: plan`. This is the next thing you want done, so it can go straight to writing-plans.
  2. The e-mail batch size of 50, as a watch item. It has `Revisit if:` the mail host rejects a batch with `421 Too many messages`, so it won't age. If you'd rather it be dropped outright, say so and I'll mark it `→ dropped:` with your reason.
- **Header change:** I first wrote "nothing deferred", but these two items make that untrue. The plan's status line now reads "deferred items in specs/deferred_items.md".

No roadmap line is in plan 15's header, so step 3a doesn't apply. Next are step 4 (backlog stats and triage) and step 5 (the deferral scan, then retiring the plan).
